entries.title: Bushido Blade

emulation.notes: Use conservative PS1 enhancements for stable weapon-fighting presentation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation presentation with high-quality PS1 emulation.

primary.why: Bushido Blade has no sourced modern remaster; the original PlayStation release is the complete version, and PS1 emulation provides the best capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PlayStation disc or image through DuckStation with original aspect ratio and conservative enhancement settings.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced modern remaster or re-release; Kengo is related by developer/gameplay but not a direct Bushido Blade entry.
